signal: REBA raised a Series A in February 2026, acquired Markerr and Amenity Analyzer, and adopted Microsoft Fabric to power its multifamily analytics platform.

email.body1:
Lona, saw REBA close its Series A and pull in Markerr and Amenity Analyzer to widen the multifamily analytics platform.

Funding plus acquisitions usually means more in-market operators in play than a team can cover before the new targets ramp. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for REBA off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Lona, quick follow-up for REBA.

Post-raise and mid-integration, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings REBA needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Lona, last bit of proof for REBA.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how REBA's reply rate likely compares to other Series-A startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Lona, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The raise-plus-integration stretch is its own kind of busy, and timing is everything.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of 3 AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-A proptech motion? I'll tailor it to REBA either way.
